corrections.text: The Analysis section states that "the company's total revenue and adjusted OIBDA improved company-wide." The cited source, SpaceNews, actually reports that total revenue declined: "Total revenue declined nearly 4% to around $3.6 billion, while adjusted operating income before depreciation and amortization (OIBDA) jumped to $681.2 million from $279.6 million." Only adjusted OIBDA improved; total revenue fell nearly 4% year-over-year.
